title: The first project is the hardest — and the most important.
story: A beginner-friendly study jam turned a blank repository into a working campus utility. The real win was learning that asking questions, sharing half-finished ideas, and shipping small are all part of building.
highlight: Started with a hello world. Left with a team.

title: One volunteer can make a whole community feel possible.
story: By welcoming new faces and making room for every question, a student volunteer helped turn a regular meetup into a place where people return, contribute, and bring their friends along.

title: The best prototypes teach you what to try next.
story: An experimental idea went through rough sketches, broken builds, and feedback from peers before becoming something worth showing. It is a reminder that progress rarely arrives polished.
highlight: Build it messy. Make it better together.
